name: Draconic for Dummies
summary: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find the book he hid on an island in the South Seas. First, find his crashed gyrocopter on Land's End Beach, then swim south. This follows Translating the Ledger.

sections.title: A Book Stowed Away
sections.body:
Narain Soothfancy says the book will come in handy, and he hid it where no one could hope to find it. He took a gyrocopter to reach the hiding place, then crashed on the beach on his way back. Narain says the crash gave him his super-gnomish psychic powers.

The wreck lies somewhere along Land's End Beach. From there, swim south. Narain is sure you will recognise the place at a glance. The book lies buried on an island in the South Seas.

sections.title: At the Island
sections.body: On the island, you find a mound of dirt, but the book is gone. A note lies on the mound in its place.

faq.q: Who sends you to find this book?
faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy sends you after the book once you finish Translating the Ledger for him.

faq.q: Where did Narain crash his gyrocopter?
faq.answer: Narain says he crashed on a beach while returning from hiding the book. His wreck lies somewhere along Land's End Beach.

faq.q: Where is the book supposed to be hidden?
faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy says the book lies buried on an island in the South Seas. Swim south from his wreck on Land's End Beach; he says you will recognise the place at a glance.

faq.q: How did Narain get his psychic powers?
faq.answer: Narain says the gyrocopter crash on the beach gave him his psychic powers.
